automatedFailuresReviewed.topic: ACS with separate indication for anticoagulation - antiplatelet strategy
automatedFailuresReviewed.defect: Generic 'individualise' key versus obviously unsafe alternatives; missing decision-critical bleeding/antithrombotic context makes the item non-discriminating and potentially unsupported.

Nested threshold options are simultaneously true in the stated patient: 'start oxygen', 'start oxygen only if below 92%', and 'start oxygen only if below 90%' all collapse to the same action at SpO2 89%.
Key/explanation inconsistency plus overlapping category options: explanation calculates CURB-65=1/low risk while keyed option indicates score 2/intermediate risk; low-risk options also overlap.

highestLeverageDefect.description: Generator/reviewer still permits nested or overlapping alternatives, especially threshold/category options, and can emit a keyed answer inconsistent with the explanation's own calculation.
highestLeverageDefect.recommendedScalableFix: Add deterministic pre-review rejection for semantically nested threshold/category options and for explicit answer-key/explanation numeric-category contradictions; keep the hostile reviewer as a second independent gate. Do not hand-edit individual generated questions.

blocker.effect: Replicates 3-5 could not generate a complete 100-variant sample, so a fresh full evaluation cannot currently validate the next compiler/reviewer change.
